propositions: Seven decorated pytest fixtures return dict(os.environ) directly or nested, exposing arbitrary ambient credentials in default long traceback output when pytest renders fixture arguments via saferepr.

Runtime probe with SIBLING_TRACE_SECRET sentinel inserted first confirmed all seven fixtures leak the secret in long traceback but not short traceback, isolating the root cause to fixture argument rendering rather than subprocess execution or stdout/stderr.
Minimal environment runs under env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin passed all 42 affected fixture consumer tests, proving no behavioral dependency on unrelated ambient variables.

Each fixture now returns an explicit allowlisted mutable mapping containing only required PATH, state paths, and per-harness overrides (HEALTH_TIMEOUT, REPL_LOG), eliminating ambient credential exposure.
Security oracle test/fixture_env_repr_security.py confirmed RED on all seven original fixtures, GREEN after allowlist fix, and returned to RED when dict(os.environ) mutation was reintroduced.
